semantics.sampling: Rising edge of clk; synchronous load and ena per original problem
semantics.priority: load high loads data instead of rotating
semantics.right: ena=01 moves old bit i to (i+99)%100
semantics.left: ena=10 moves old bit i to (i+1)%100
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No initial value specified; no initialization added
semantics.latency: q updates on the accepting rising edge, without extra cycles

numeric.wrap: Rotation preserves every bit including boundary bits
numeric.arithmetic: No rounding, saturation, or arithmetic overflow

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit index mapping derived from original problem
verification.sampling: Drive on falling edges, check stability before rising edge, sample after nonblocking updates
verification.cases: Load priority for all ena values; both hold values; one-hot boundary and all positions; full rotations; alternating and random data; zero and all ones
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation with fatal mismatch and explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities: Initial q and unknown control behavior are unspecified; do not add initialization or require a defined power-up value.
Clock edge is implicit in the synchronous register description; use conventional rising-edge operation.
